meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或简报变成宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正需要为产品发布制作宣传视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or brief into a promo video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product and need a promo video

howto.what: Claude 会把产品网址、粘贴的脚本或任务简报做成产品发布/促销视频：先确认简报、抓取网页素材、定设计风格，再写分镜和旁白，逐帧制作画面，最后渲染成 mp4。全程分步骤执行，每步有检查点，会调用配套技能（如 /media-use、/hyperframes）。
howto.when: 当你想营销、发布或推广产品等时触发；默认用于商业网址，网站导览等请求也走这里。不清楚时转到 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这款 SaaS 的落地页做成 30 秒产品发布视频
say.note: 会先抓取该网址素材再走完整流程

say.text: 这是我们的发布脚本，做成一条促销视频
say.note: 脚本会作为旁白底稿处理

say.text: 给公司官网做一个展示视频，按页面原样呈现
say.note: 走网站导览路线，截图作为画面主体

howto.what_en: Claude turns a URL, script, or brief into a launch/promo video: confirm brief, capture assets, set design, write storyboard/script, build frames, render mp4. Runs stepwise with gates; calls /media-use and /hyperframes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, or promote a product; defaults to any commercial URL, and site-tour requests route here too. Unclear cases go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this SaaS landing page into a 30-second product launch video.
Here's our launch script; make a promo video from it.
Make a showcase video of our company site, shown as-is.
say_en.note: Routes to the site-tour path with real screenshots.
